caption_methods.description: List of caption extraction methods: 'txt', 'xmp', 'exif', 'cmt', or 'none'. Multiple may be combined.

max_full_width.description: Maximum width of full-size preview images in pixels.

max_full_height.description: Maximum height of full-size preview images in pixels.

max_thumb_width.description: Maximum width of thumbnails in pixels.

max_thumb_height.description: Maximum height of thumbnails in pixels.

min_thumb_width.description: Minimum width of thumbnails in pixels.

min_thumb_height.description: Minimum height of thumbnails in pixels.

threads.description: Number of threads to use. 0 means auto-detect.

include_panoramas.description: If false, disables automatic full-size panorama inclusion (-p).

include_download.description: If false, disables ZIP album download (-d).

slim.description: If true, produces slim output (no originals/downloads) (-s).

face_detect.description: If true, enables face detection for thumbnail cropping (-f).

geobase.description: Base URL for geolocation maps (implies -g if non-empty).

index_url.description: URL for index and back buttons (e.g., '/gallery/').
